title: nothing hangs off the git post-commit hook
intention: Nothing hangs off the git post-commit hook: the post_commit fan-out tool, the counting_block machine, and CodeMother's commit feeder (post_commit.py, her hooks/post-commit, its probe and proof) are deleted, the installed hook is removed, and the callers that named them are edited, so a commit runs no Cairn code.
why: Outline 9.4.3.3.2 (Akien): 'Checking what a change touched belongs here; nothing hangs off the git post-commit hook.' 17.11.5: 'Measuring who did what serves none of that': counting_block's whole job is learning who writes what. Rule 1.3.7: code no longer needed is deleted. Measured 2026-11-08: every cairn commit prints counting_block's fold line from the installed fan-out.
how: Extend the shared retirement proof with four teeth (red first); delete the two folders and CodeMother's four files, records through artifact remove; edit the trouble store and its proof, the charter proof and the ground_loop proof; remove the installed hook; close the who-writes-what troubles quoting 17.11.5; recompile the lab.

clauses.claim: cairn/tools/post_commit, cairn/machines/counting_block and CodeMother's post_commit.py, hooks/post-commit, probes/commit_fires_activations.py and proofs/test_a_commit_reaches_the_watcher.py are absent, and git ls-files lists no */hooks/post-commit
no repo file outside records of truth and caches names cairn.tools.post_commit, cairn.machines.counting_block or cairn.devices.codemother.post_commit, or their paths
importing each of the three modules exits nonzero with No module named
no post-commit hook is installed in the repo's git common dir

decisions.text: D1: extend the red-first proof bin/proofs/test_retired_components_are_gone.py with PROVES['6935a4a71f93'] = {'1': 'post_commit_chain_paths_are_absent', '2': 'nothing_names_the_post_commit_chain', '3': 'the_post_commit_chain_does_not_import', '4': 'no_post_commit_hook_is_installed'}. Tooth 1: cairn/tools/post_commit, cairn/machines/counting_block, cairn/devices/codemother/post_commit.py, cairn/devices/codemother/hooks/post-commit, cairn/devices/codemother/probes/commit_fires_activations.py and cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_a_commit_reaches_the_watcher.py are absent, and git ls-files '*/hooks/post-commit' lists nothing. Tooth 2: _naming over the three modules and three paths (spelled split, so the proof never names them whole) finds nothing. Tooth 3: python3 -c 'import X' exits nonzero with 'No module named' for cairn.tools.post_commit.fanout, cairn.machines.counting_block.block and cairn.devices.codemother.post_commit. Tooth 4: <git rev-parse --git-common-dir>/hooks/post-commit does not exist. The quarry teeth are unchanged. Run red before the build: all four FAIL.

D2: delete cairn/tools/post_commit/ and cairn/machines/counting_block/ whole. Records of truth leave first through bin/cairn artifact remove <path> --why: each intention+why.json and every validations/*.json; then git rm -r the rest (history.json and state.json go with the folder; git keeps them).

D3: in CodeMother delete post_commit.py, hooks/post-commit (the hooks folder empties and goes), probes/commit_fires_activations.py, proofs/test_a_commit_reaches_the_watcher.py and validations/test_a_commit_reaches_the_watcher.json (artifact remove). In proofs/test_watch.py delete class TestLivenessProbe (it tests the deleted probe) and change line 1 to 'Proofs for the watcher face: codemother/watch.py, reached through her bus verbs.' watch.py, on_commit and the shim's commit verb stay (outline 9.3.3).

D4: trouble: delete store.clears from cairn/devices/trouble/tools/store/store.py (its only caller was counting_block) and drop it from the store charter's what and invoke lines; in cairn/devices/trouble/proofs/test_trouble_never_rides_the_bus.py delete test_the_tool_reads_the_clears and its docstring row, drop tool.clears from the no-host tooth's script, and rename test_the_three_readers_read_with_no_bus to test_the_two_readers_read_with_no_bus (label, docstring row and the call list), reading only the pane and web_server rows. The module docstring's measured line keeps its history (counting_block asking verb clears is what was measured) and adds that ticket 6935a4a71f93 retired that reader.

D5: cairn/tools/charter/proofs/test_the_two_bypass_rows_carry_their_predecessors_standing.py: REPAIRED keeps only the tester row; the docstring says the counting_block row left with its machine (ticket 6935a4a71f93). cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/proofs/test_the_beat_calls_nothing.py: delete test_codemother_hears_the_commit_through_the_fanout and PROVES['164da559823d'] key '6', with a docstring line that ticket 6935a4a71f93 retired that clause (outline 9.4.3.3.2), as 164da559823d D6 did for bae622881f03.

D6: host and records: check the installed .git/hooks/post-commit carries the marker cairn-post-commit-fanout, then delete it. Close each live who-writes-what-* trouble with bin/cairn trouble clear <id> --by cc --what-changed 'counting_block retired (ticket 6935a4a71f93); outline 17.11.5, Akien: Measuring who did what serves none of that.' Recompile the lab with cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/recompile_gate.sh so the two charter copies go.

D7: run the proof green twice, then every edited proof once (test_trouble_never_rides_the_bus.py, test_watch.py, the charter proof, test_the_beat_calls_nothing.py, bin's proof); commit; seal the retirement proof; PROVEME; hollow seal.

measured.saw: each cairn commit prints a counting_block fold line from the installed fan-out; 10 live who-writes-what-* troubles in the trouble store
measured.how: git commit output; ls of the trouble store under the cairn logs tree
